basic_info.description: Charming home with endless possibilities! Updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath home with thoughtful upgrades, including new kitchen appliances and windows throughout the main floor. The main floor features crown molding in the living and dining rooms, and a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom connects the primary and guest bedroom. Multiple versatile bonus spaces provide ample flexibility, including a room with a wet bar, another bonus area previously a garage, and an additional bonus room downstairs. There's also a convenient mud room with access to the backyard, plus a full bathroom downstairs. Parts of the  driveway and sidewalk have been recently updated, adding a polished finish.  Perfect for those looking to customize and create a dream home! Schedule your showing today!
